title: PROVEN object enumeration: 6/12 adjacent IDs on /cases/:id expose another identity's object
description: Object identifier "100" is sequential and contiguous (span 13). Requesting the 12 adjacent IDs returned 6 responses carrying another identity's data (50% of probes). Owned object baseline: status 200, 212 bytes. Samples: 101, 103, 105. Observed while authenticated as alice.
